cases.name: participant_binding_invalid
assertions: unanchored participant_binding issuer maps to participant_binding_invalid at reducer admission
tuple mismatch maps to participant_binding_invalid while preserving schema validity
expired participant_binding maps to participant_binding_invalid
signature verification failure maps to participant_binding_invalid
fully valid participant_binding control is accepted

cases.name: initial_state_accepts_allowed
assertions: scheduled, ringing, and connecting are the only accepted initial states
active and terminal initial states fail with call_state_transition_invalid

cases.name: transition_matrix
assertions: every call-state.md legal transition edge is accepted
representative non-terminal illegal edges fail with call_state_transition_invalid
non-terminal illegal edges are not reported as call_state_terminal

cases.name: terminal_absorbing
assertions: ended, missed, failed, and cancelled reject every outgoing transition
terminal outgoing attempts fail with call_state_terminal
the original terminal head remains unchanged

cases.name: replay_same_state_noop
assertions: same-basis replay of ringing to connecting is idempotent
duplicate equivalent transitions keep the final head at connecting
duplicate equivalent transitions do not surface call_state_transition_invalid

cases.name: ordered_competing_transitions
assertions: ringing to active and ringing to missed compete in the confirmed sequence; the first valid command advances the revision
the command evaluated second against the stale revision is durably rejected with no state effect
the result follows the confirmed Seal order and never creates sibling heads or Bottom

cases.name: axis_cell_split
assertions: moderation commands are evaluated in confirmed order; a command on a stale revision is durably rejected and can be re-authored against the new revision
a competing capture transition commits at most one value for its prior revision; the stale command is rejected without affecting the main call-state axis
roster and moderation add tags equal event_id and their values equal the selected payload value
roster leave and moderation restore remove exactly the payload observed_dot
mute override validation sets the complete per-leg payload value
capture lifecycle transition and capture result are projected into separate exact cell writes
any derived projection kind, tag, value, from, or to mismatch fails with reducer_projection_failed
an unchanged axis produces no projected write and a redundant same-value write is rejected
focus validation sets the complete focus value and cannot omit or replace a committed session_focus
all safety axes use sequenced_state and never produce sibling heads or Bottom
